name: Tri-Valley Teen Job and Career Fair
org: City of Dublin, with San Ramon, Pleasanton, Danville and the Dublin/San Ramon Women's Club
city: San Ramon, CA (Alcosta Senior and Community Center)
what_you_do: You go to a free fair to explore job openings around the Tri-Valley.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 19 in the Tri-Valley area.
pay_detail: Free to attend. This is a fair, not a job.
deadline_text: Saturday, February 27, 2027, 12:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. The program page does not describe registration.
how_to_apply: The program page does not say whether you must register. It says to bring several copies of your resume and to dress professionally.
notes: Location: 9300 Alcosta Blvd, San Ramon. The program page does not list which employers will come. Questions: Dublin City Hall, 100 Civic Plaza, 925-833-6650.
